title: Prepayment, Cancellation and Unused-Night Terms Table for the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement
content:
Under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement each stay type has its own prepayment deadline, free-cancellation period, late-cancellation and no-show fee nights, and treatment of booked nights left unused after an early departure. Fees expressed in nights are charged at the stay's locked nightly rate.

## Terms by stay type

| Stay type | Prepayment due (calendar days before the planned arrival date) | Free-cancellation period (calendar days before the planned arrival date) | Late-cancellation fee (nights at the locked nightly rate) | No-show fee (nights at the locked nightly rate) | Unused nights after an early departure credited beyond the minimum stay |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 3 | 7 | 1 | 2 | Yes |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 3 | 7 | 2 | 3 | Yes |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 3 | 7 | 2 | 3 | Yes |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 3 | 7 | 2 | 3 | Yes |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 3 | 7 | 2 | 3 | Yes |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 0 | 2 | 1 | 1 | Yes |

## Meaning of each column

- **Prepayment due** is the number of calendar days before the planned arrival date by which the minimum-stay charge must be paid. For the Post-Hospital Recovery Stay the figure is 0, which places the deadline on the planned arrival date itself.
- **Free-cancellation period** is the number of calendar days before the planned arrival date up to which a cancellation carries no fee.
- **Late-cancellation fee** is the number of nights, at the locked nightly rate, charged as the fee for a cancellation inside the free-cancellation period.
- **No-show fee** is the number of nights, at the locked nightly rate, charged when the guest does not arrive.
- **Unused nights credited** answers whether booked nights not used after an early departure are credited, beyond the minimum stay. It is "Yes" for every stay type.

## Hypothetical fee illustration

For a hypothetical Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) whose locked nightly rate is 284.00, the late-cancellation fee of 2 nights is 568.00 and the no-show fee of 3 nights is 852.00. For a hypothetical Post-Hospital Recovery Stay locked at 398.00, both fees are 1 night, 398.00.
